title: Three data entry points
summary: Prices and bars use get_history_data; macro and benchmarks use get_reference_data; attributes use get_static_data. get_kline is OHLCV sugar, not a fourth door.
narrative:
qteasy exposes three read-only data entries. They are not one catch-all API.

- history: time × share series via get_history_data. Stock prices, valuations, and related htypes go here. get_kline is OHLCV sugar on the same history path; it is not a fourth entry.
- reference: time-only series via get_reference_data. Macro series and benchmarks such as close-000300.SH go here. Do not pull GDP or a market benchmark through get_history_data "on the side".
- static: share-only attributes via get_static_data. Industry, list_date, and names go here.

History reads can later be gathered into a HistoryPanel for multi-share analysis; that container is a separate topic. Ask names the three doors. Plan data.read picks a channel from your wording. Mixing shapes in one call is not supported. Download and refill are a different Job from read.
python_code:
import qteasy as qt
print('history', hasattr(qt, 'get_history_data'), 'kline', hasattr(qt, 'get_kline'))
print('reference', hasattr(qt, 'get_reference_data'))
print('static', hasattr(qt, 'get_static_data'))
risk_notes: Mixing channels in one call is not supported. Download/refill is a different Job from read.
